summary_en: The paper introduces photo-activated ultrasound localization imaging, in which laser-triggered nanodroplets provide on-demand, spatially and temporally controlled ultrasound contrast. A programmable interleaved laser and ultrafast-ultrasound sequence enables super-resolved microvascular reconstruction and hemodynamic mapping. Because optical activation, acoustic acquisition, and image reconstruction are all central to the method, it is a strong core addition to the acoustic-optics imaging collection.

summary_en: MOBILE is a miniaturized photoacoustic imaging platform built around an omnidirectional broadband fiber-optic ultrasound sensor. It supports vessel-resolved dynamic monitoring with approximately 40 micrometer resolution to a depth of 10 millimeters and can be integrated into handheld or wearable configurations. The paper is a direct systems-and-image-formation contribution and belongs in the repository's core photoacoustic imaging library.
